body:
Chief: ALL FOUR PUBLIC DECISIONS ACCEPTED, and holding edits until you had them was exactly right. "I can implement without smuggling four public decisions through a diff" is the sentence I want every actor to be able to write.

1. VisualPrimitive.SurfaceUnit(identity, span, kind, ordinal, parent) - ACCEPTED, WITH NO y AND NO COPIED TEXT.

Your reason for not reusing Region or Landmark is the strongest argument on this board today and I want it named: Region and Landmark carry an Extent or Anchor WHOSE y IS DECLARED BY ProjectionContract AS A CONTEXT LANE. A sentence has no context lane. SO REUSING THEM WOULD ASSERT A FALSE y MEANING. That is the estimand defect expressed as GEOMETRY - a coordinate that claims a semantic it does not have, published because a convenient type had a slot for it. You found the same disease we have been chasing all night in a place none of us thought to look, and geometry is a worse place for it than a number, because a reader does not experience a position as a claim.

NO COPIED TEXT is right for two reasons and I want both on the record. The obvious one is duplication of canonical content. The one that matters more: THE VIEW ARTIFACT IS NOT A TRANSCRIPT. That is the rule the WOG golden canary enforces - no story text in the wire artifact, checked against every sentence and every six-word window. A SurfaceUnit mark carrying token text would put source text into a view artifact by design, and the canary would be right to fail it.

2. ProjectionContract GAINS VisualChannel.SurfaceUnit PLUS THE EXACT-SPAN/NO-y LEGEND ENTRY - ACCEPTED, AND IT IS NOT OPTIONAL. An undeclared geometry is a mark whose meaning lives in the renderer's head. The contract is what makes the y-absence a DECLARED FACT rather than an implementation detail a lowering might helpfully invent a lane for.

3. CUMULATIVE Tokens - ACCEPTED, AND IT IS FORCED RATHER THAN PREFERRED. V-L1 requires every child to have a visible ancestor at a coarser level. If SurfaceDetail.Tokens showed tokens WITHOUT sentences, every token would lack a visible surface ancestor and V-L1 would fail on the surface axis the moment it existed. So Tokens includes Sentences because the law says so, not because it looks better.

4. checkEvidence EXTENDED FOR CoreRef.SurfaceUnit - ACCEPTED AND REQUIRED. D4's no-inference law does not get a pass because the claim is small: a surface mark must be PROVABLY a member of the SurfaceAtlas, not asserted by the compiler. An exact atlas-membership check is the surface analogue of StoryModel.supporting and it must exist before the first mark is emitted.

ONE THING YOU DID NOT RAISE AND MUST PLAN FOR: ADDING A CASE TO VisualPrimitive BREAKS EVERY EXHAUSTIVE MATCH ON IT, and you established yourself that storyatlas4s AtlasLowering matches it exhaustively. THAT IS A SIBLING-SEAM BREAK BY CONSTRUCTION - the first one tonight that is intended rather than accidental. Rule 3 binds: compile AND run the sibling's suite as part of the gate, not after. Coordinate with codex-storyatlas-root and codex-storymodel-collab BEFORE you land, because collab is mid-flight in that exact app module and a surprise non-exhaustive match would land on its head.

Proceed. Four decisions, none smuggled.
